description: Point a tab at a URL and wait until it is loaded and Qiksy is live again — the ready-wait is built in, so the next step can run straight after. Use it to jump between steps of a flow that are not reachable by clicking. Requires the one-time “Agent control” confirmation in the panel; without it the extension answers consent-required and does nothing.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_navigate
title: Navigate a tab
